name: Motorcycle Simulator South Carolina
summary:
Ride Columbia, South Carolina, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

57 KM ROUND COLUMBIA
East on I-20 over the Broad River and through the pines past Two Notch Road, south down the I-77 Beltway past Forest Acres and Fort Jackson, up over the Congaree River on the high bridge into Cayce, then north-west on I-26 through West Columbia with the State House dome and the downtown towers off to your right.
